cache/mha: While generating, each layer caches a key and a value per head for every token. With h of four heads, each eight numbers wide, that is two times four times eight: sixty four numbers per token.
cache/gqa: Grouped-query attention, with g of two key-value heads, halves that to thirty two, but heads in a group then read the very same keys and values.
cache/own: Latent attention, from DeepSeek in 2024, makes the cache smaller still, while every head keeps keys and values of its own.
latent/down: It sends each token's vector, x, of d numbers, through one matrix, W D K V: D for down, K V for keys and values.
latent/latent: Out comes a short vector, c, the latent, of d c numbers: here sixteen. A row per number it makes, a column per entry of x: W D K V is d c by d.
latent/store: Only c goes into the cache: sixteen numbers per token, per layer.
latent/up: When attention runs, head i rebuilds its key from c with its part of an up-projection, W U K, U for up: d head by d c, eight by sixteen. Its part of W U V rebuilds its value.
latent/own: Each head has its own part, so each still gets its own key and value. Stacked, the four parts make W U K h times d head by d c: thirty two by sixteen.
latent/count: These matrices are weights, stored once, not per token. So per token and layer: sixty four numbers, then thirty two, and now only d c, sixteen.
real/big: DeepSeek-V2 has a hundred and twenty eight heads, each a hundred and twenty eight wide. Multi-head attention would cache thirty two thousand seven hundred sixty eight numbers per token, per layer.
real/small: Its latent has five hundred twelve numbers, plus one small key of sixty four, shared by every head, that carries the token's position: five hundred seventy six in all.
try/p: Try one: sixteen heads, each sixty four wide, and a latent of d c two hundred fifty six. How many numbers per token are cached, against multi-head attention?
try/mha: Multi-head would cache two times sixteen times sixty four: two thousand and forty eight.
try/lat: Latent attention caches only c, two hundred fifty six: eight times smaller.
try/shape: And one head's part of W U K makes sixty four numbers from two hundred fifty six: sixty four by two hundred fifty six.
